policy: Use Electron for native input, IPC, restart persistence, PTY lifecycle and real accessibility-tree checks.
Pure renderer decisions belong in renderer state or component tests; Storybook is not installed.
Every spec names the cross-process or native contract. Scope-deferred contracts are documented in docs/enterprise/phase-reports/phase-6.md.

accessibility.spec.ts.electron: Chromium accessibility tree for the real Electron shell and IPC-backed pages

composer-directory-reference.spec.ts.electron: the folder reference has to survive a renderer reload and still agree with the Host's session record

new-task-reload.spec.ts.electron: renderer reload must preserve an explicit new task and rebuild archived-only Host history as an empty, usable new-task surface

partial-history-notice.spec.ts.electron: bounded history paging and tail restoration cross renderer, preload and Host storage

proxy-password-editing.spec.ts.electron: write-only credential persistence and actual authentication against a loopback proxy

quote-window-boundary.spec.ts.electron: a pointer capture released outside the window -- there is no window edge to leave in a browser tab

rename-focus.spec.ts.electron: native Electron keyboard events must reach the rename field immediately after menu dismissal or a row double-click

session-draft-focus.spec.ts.electron: needs a second real Session (Host round trip) to switch to; the focus and draft-restore halves alone would not earn a window

session-local-recovery.spec.ts.electron: First-send refusal cleanup, inherited Host defaults, durable admission, delivery UI controls and reload/restart recovery cross renderer, preload and Main

session-workbar.spec.ts.electron: per-session pane persistence, Git focus refresh, and real PTY ownership and stop across sessions

settings.spec.ts.electron: Host settings writes survive renderer reload, while settings navigation restores the active session workbar

page-history.spec.ts.electron: header navigation restores IPC-backed task views and drafts across settings navigation and preserves native sidebar hover behavior

sidebar-toggle-stability.spec.ts.electron: native pointer hover followed by a click must preserve titlebar icon geometry through the preview-to-expanded transition

sidebar-persistence.spec.ts.electron: manual section and project expansion must survive renderer reload, project rename through IPC and full Electron restart

sidebar-project-reload.spec.ts.electron: Projects and Recents rebuild the real Host catalog after renderer reload

skill-draft-lifecycle.spec.ts.electron: persisted skill document reload and submission through preload to the real Host

slash-command-compact.spec.ts.electron: /compact is a Host round trip that ends in a real terminal Turn state

streaming-remount.spec.ts.electron: observation seeding, reconnect and settle are Host subscriptions surviving a renderer remount

transcript-scroll-cost.spec.ts.electron: the perf budget is measured from CDP wheel input and the browser's own render skipping

zh-tw-locale.spec.ts.electron: the locale is a persisted Host setting and only takes effect through a renderer reload
